'partial' marks a meta whose last resume overwrote part of its pass: its figure is a floor and the rest falls to D39's invoice residual. Built in the S160 register repair from two read-only surveys (the Era-1 subtrees, and the rest), reviewed against the register; the generator scripts/build_archive_ledger.py prices it into data/pricing/archive-executions.json. A new usage-bearing archive meta must be classified here before the ledger builds.
